_comment_api_keys: Set api_key, api_secret, session_token here or via env (run_simulation.sh). Do not commit real keys to version control.

api._comment_env: AX PRODUCTION (real funds): https://gateway.architect.exchange/api. To use the sandbox (paper money) instead, swap host to https://gateway.sandbox.architect.exchange/api and the matching wss://gateway.sandbox.architect.exchange/orders/ws ws_endpoint.
api._comment_fill_poll_cursor_file: Value passed to GET /fills ?cursor= (OpenAPI). Persisted max trade_id so restarts do not replay historic fills as orphans.
api._comment_fill_poll_use_cursor_query_para: true = query param "cursor" (per docs). false = legacy "after" if your gateway still expects it.
api._comment_position_refresh_interval_sec: PositionBook snapshot cadence. pollExchangePositions runs every position_poll_interval_sec (5s) for PnL; every position_refresh_interval_sec (30s, clamped >= poll interval) it ALSO feeds that same getPositions() response into PositionBook::applySnapshotBatch (NO extra REST). Only active when market_maker.position_book_mode != off.
api._comment_venue_orders_refresh_interval_s: ENFORCE-mode only. Main-loop cadence at which one GET /open-orders per ENFORCE symbol refreshes VenueOrdersCache. In enforce, the mover (order) thread issues ZERO venue GETs and reads this cache instead. Off/shadow symbols are never fetched here (legacy behavior byte-for-byte).
api._comment_venue_cache_max_age_ms: ENFORCE-mode only. If a mover reader finds the VenueOrdersCache older than this, it logs VENUE_CACHE_STALE once and PROCEEDS on local order-state as truth — it never fetches inline and never blocks.

polling._comment_polling: Pillar C — dedicated continuous fills+positions poller (FastPoller). When enabled a background thread performs GET /fills and GET /positions off the main loop and hands raw bodies back; the main loop parses+applies them (PositionBook single-writer preserved). Rate-governed (429/Retry-After backoff, RTT-degradation halving) and self-healing (respawn x3 then fall back to legacy inline). When disabled, fills/positions are polled inline on the ~1s tick exactly as before.
polling._comment_fast_poller_enabled: false (default) = legacy inline polling on the ~1s main-loop tick. true = spawn the FastPoller. Ignored when market_maker.paper_simulate_fills is true.
polling._comment_intervals: Minimum ms between successive fills / positions fetches. Defaults 300 / 1000 (2026-07-13). 0 is still allowed = back-to-back (a new query as soon as the previous is applied, natural cadence == venue RTT ~86ms), but is NO LONGER the default: constant back-to-back polling soft-throttled the whole account and inflated order RTT to ~210ms. Raise to throttle further.
polling._comment_poll_min_interval_ms: Extra floor (ms) slept between full fills+positions cycles. 0 = none.
polling._comment_expected_rtt_ms: Self-throttle governor reference. The degradation baseline is min(expected_rtt_ms, the session-minimum RTT observed) — NOT the rolling median, which baselines at the already-throttled value and goes blind. If the rolling median exceeds self_throttle_hi_factor * ref for self_throttle_min_samples consecutive samples, the poller halves its frequency (POLLER_SELF_THROTTLE) and keeps halving until the median recovers below self_throttle_lo_factor * ref. Heartbeat prints ref_rtt_ms and min_rtt_ms.
polling._comment_backoff: Rate governor: on HTTP 429 (or Retry-After) the poller backs off exponentially from backoff_base_ms up to backoff_cap_ms (Retry-After honored when present). Its budget is sacrificial — order traffic always wins. Backoff at back-to-back cadence is EXPECTED and logged calmly as POLLER_BACKOFF, not an error.

external_feed.name: neon_fx_quote
external_feed.description: neon_fix: FIX 4.4 quote session through stunnel. Optional: same-dir external_feed.local.json merges after this file (see external_feed.local.example.json).

fix._comment_tls: direct_tls true: Python TLS to Neon (tls_server_name = SNI). false: TCP only to stunnel on host:port.

mettraders_feed._comment: Mettraders market-data websocket. Parses {ts,bid,ask} and publishes a quote keyed by `fix_symbol` (default GOLD) into the same quotes_by_canonical map used by Neon/HL. Pill goes green only after the first parsed quote — handshake alone is reported separately via mettraders_ws_connected_.

trading._comment_feed_guardian: Each ~15s: if Architect order WebSocket is disconnected OR external pricing transport is down (FIX before/after logon, or REST poll failed), cancel-all per watchlist+MM symbols; if none, cancel-all account. Then clear OM + strategy tracking.

fees._comment: Maker fee: 0.02%, Taker fee: 0.25% (example; confirm on your Architect account)

logging._comment_toggles: Enable/disable specific log categories - toggle to false to reduce latency

hedge._comment: Hedge configuration - tracks exposure in notional USD. Set symbol, multiplier, and initial_price for your hedge venue when enabled.
hedge._comment_example: Example: notional_per_contract = initial_price × multiplier; hedge when |net_usd| exceeds threshold_ratio × that notional.
hedge._comment_logic: SELL hedge if net_pos > +threshold (long exposure), BUY hedge if net_pos < -threshold (short exposure)

market_maker._comment_mover_shard_per_instrument: true = one dedicated order-mover thread per instrument (spawned on first use, never reaped) so a slow reconcile/cancel on one product no longer blocks others; cap correctness is preserved (all stacks of a product share that product's thread). false = single global serial mover (legacy). Set true to stop products like WTI being starved behind gold/SPY on one shared mover.
market_maker._comment_place_before_cancel_ack: Pillar B fire-and-track (ENFORCE mode only; ignored in off/shadow). false (default) = classic cancel-replace: on a theo move send the pair cancels, wait for the cancel acks, THEN re-add. true = send the pair cancels then IMMEDIATELY read effective() once and place the fresh pair WITHOUT waiting for the acks (wire order cancel,cancel,place,place). Old legs go to CANCEL_SENT_UNCONFIRMED and are resolved async (ack/fill/venue-absence). LOOSENS the 2026-07-03 post-cancel-confirm gating: transient exposure bound max_position + 2*order_size per side, self-corrected within one fills-poll interval. Flipping true is an operator/Tim decision.
market_maker._comment_async_batch_submit: Latency optimization for the fire-and-track pair place (requires place_before_cancel_ack=true; ignored otherwise). false (default) = each leg's place is a blocking HTTP call issued serially on the mover thread, so a 2-leg re-add costs ~2 sequential place-RTTs. true = both legs are reserved+created WITHOUT firing (submit_order_no_dispatch), then their wires are fired CONCURRENTLY via Platform::placeOrdersConcurrent (one curl-multi batch), so the pair completes in ~1 RTT. The per-leg ORDER_ACCEPTED dispatch (and the reservation-balancing accept counter) is identical to the sync path; only the wire dispatch is parallelized. Reserve-before-fire ordering is preserved so the pending-accept counter stays balanced regardless of completion order (see test_batch_place_accept_ordering).
market_maker._comment_concurrent_cancels: Classic cancel-replace latency fix (applies to the wait-for-ack path, i.e. place_before_cancel_ack=false). true (default) = on a theo-move pair-cancel, BOTH stale-leg cancels fire together in ONE curl-multi batch (~1 venue RTT) instead of two serial mover jobs (~2 RTT); the fresh pair is still placed only AFTER both cancels are venue-confirmed. DEAD-SAFE: only the HTTP transport is parallelised — each leg keeps the identical validation, venue-truth guard and om.cancelOrder() bookkeeping as the serial path, so the event-driven cancel-ack -> replace flow and the no-duplicate guarantee are unchanged; a leg whose cancel hard-fails is left CANCEL_PENDING for the async cancel-timeout reconcile (never dropped, never re-placed). false = strictly-serial per-leg cancels (legacy).
market_maker._comment_curl_warm_connections: Warm-connection pool (Fix 1). A combined cancel+place batch fires N requests at once; if fewer than N keep-alive connections are warm, the extras open fresh TCP+TLS (~3 RTT each) and batch_rtt degrades from ~1 RTT to ~N RTT. The CurlMultiManager keeps this many connections hot in the shared connection cache (pre-warmed at startup, refreshed by the idle keepalive) so every batch leg reuses one (reused=1 connect=0 tls=0 in the [BATCH_REQ] trace). 0 disables warming. Default 6 covers a 4-leg combined batch with headroom.
market_maker._comment_curl_keepalive_touch_sec: Idle threshold (seconds) before the keepalive touch fires curl_warm_connections concurrent cheap GETs to the gateway to keep the warm pool hot. Venues/LBs typically close idle connections at 30-60s, so keep this well below that. Runs on the manager's pinger thread; borrows only free pool handles so it never delays order traffic, and is NOT counted in MM_JOB_VENUE_CALLS (raw curl, not routed through the counted RestClient methods).
market_maker._comment_batch_req_trace: true (default) = log one [BATCH_REQ] i=N kind=cancel|place connect_ms tls_ms starttransfer_ms reused=0|1 line per request inside every order batch. This is the acceptance instrumentation for the warm-connection fix: after warm-up every leg should show reused=1 connect=0 tls=0 and batch_rtt ~= max(starttransfer). Set false to silence once validated.
market_maker._comment_snapshot_log_interval_ms: POSITION_SNAPSHOT log hygiene (Fix 4). A changed snapshot/effective for a symbol ALWAYS logs (drift evidence). Otherwise idle all-zero lines are collapsed to at most ONE liveness line per this interval across the WHOLE desk (a single shared gate refreshed by any logged line), so N idle symbols no longer each heartbeat. Default 5000 (~12 idle lines/min total). Raise to quiet further; drift lines are never suppressed.
market_maker._comment_cancel_confirm_timeout_ms: Fire-and-track only: if a CANCEL_SENT_UNCONFIRMED leg is not confirmed (ack/fill/venue-absence) within this many ms, re-send the cancel once (WARN CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED_RETRY); still unresolved after a second window -> mark for reconcile and log ERROR. Never blocks the order job.
market_maker._comment_venue_truth_evict_grace_ms: Dead-safe propagation/adoption grace for venue-truth reconcile eviction. A tracked leg whose exchange_oid was learned within this many ms is NEVER evicted by the venue-truth pass, even if the current /open-orders snapshot does not yet list it (venue ack->open-orders visibility lag or a snapshot that predates the place/adopt). Prevents the ACTIVE->VENUE_ORPHANED->recover->re-place duplicate seen live 2026-07-14 (EURUSD mm_req 803a7859 adopted at 08:27:04, wrongly evicted 08:27:05, leaving orphan orders). Only DELAYS eviction of freshly-established legs; a genuinely-dead leg is still evicted once the grace elapses, and cancel/fill transitions are unaffected. Set 0 to disable (restores pre-fix behavior).
market_maker._comment_inflight_pessimistic_gate: Fire-and-track optional tightener (default false). false = the re-add reduce-only gate uses effective() net only (Tim's net-only spec). true = the gate additionally biases each side by the worst-case still-unconfirmed leg qty on that side, so a side that could breach if its unconfirmed cancel loses the race is not re-added. Enabling changes Tim's net-only gate spec and is default-off pending his approval.
market_maker._comment_position_book_mode: off | shadow | enforce. off = PositionBook inert, binary is byte-for-byte legacy. shadow (default) = PositionBook fully runs (seed, onFill, 30s snapshots, drift + would-have-enforced logs) but changes NO live behavior and removes NO legacy exchange check; the ONLY new effect is log lines (grep POSITION_SNAPSHOT / CAP_SHADOW to review delta_vs_legacy accuracy). enforce = local-truth: hot-path REST neutralized, all readers on effective(), snapshot cap enforcement acts. Revert any problem by setting off and restarting — no rebuild.
market_maker._comment_position_book_mode_per_symbol: Optional per-AX override map, e.g. { "XAU-PERP": "enforce" }. A symbol absent here uses position_book_mode. Lets you enforce one small instrument while the rest stay in shadow.
market_maker._comment_symbol: AX perpetual symbol - prices derived from theo_symbol
market_maker._comment_order_size_step: Global default. For market_maker.instruments[], set order_size_step (alias order_step, contract_step) on each leg; it fills manual_stacks and desk orders.json stacks when they omit step.
market_maker._comment_order_size: Integer contracts to quote on each side
market_maker._comment_quantity: 100,000 notional per side (matching example from spec)
market_maker._comment_theo: External feed symbol (FIX 55 for neon_fix; REST venues use their native symbol)
market_maker._comment_tick: Must match AX /instruments tick for this product
market_maker._comment_width: Per-side width in basis points of the pricing mid (desk spec 2026-05-12). bid_offset = mid*W/10000, ask_offset = mid*W/10000 → with bid_w==ask_w==W the placed pair is 2*W bps apart before tick rounding (skew is common-mode and cancels in the span). 'width' is the symmetric default; override per side with bid_width / ask_width.
market_maker._comment_bid_ask_width: Optional per-side override in bps (NOT ticks); omit both to use 'width' for both legs. Asymmetric values trigger a one-shot MM_CONFIG WARN at startup.
market_maker._comment_spread_ticks: Legacy alias for the symmetric width (bps). 'width' is preferred.
market_maker._comment_max_position: If |net| >= max_position, only keep the cover side quote live
market_maker._comment_adjust_ticks: Multiplier on floor(net/adjust_position) for skew in price ticks
market_maker._comment_reload_on_fill: Ignored for matched fills: processFill always full cancel+requote when MM enabled and theo exists.
market_maker._comment_churn: Leave at 0 for fixed client width: post_fill_extra_ticks>0 widens only the filled side (breaks exact 2·width pair span). resting_depth_extra_ticks>0 adds the same extra to both half-spreads (pair wider than 2·width).
market_maker._comment_feed_log: feed_log_verbose=false: banner when rounded targets change (or first theo). feed_log_banner_min_interval_ms debounces rapid target flip-flop; 0=off. true verbose = log every tiny mid move.
market_maker._comment_gateway_open_orders_reconcile: If >0, every N seconds compare GET /open-orders to local OrderManager actives; if the venue no longer lists an exchange OID (e.g. user cancelled on the exchange GUI), mark the local order CANCELLED so MM strategies clear bid/ask ids. Default 0=off. Try 15–60 with mm_req_* stacks.
market_maker._comment_desk_width: Desk mm_req_*: if orders.json omits stack width, C++ uses instruments[ax].default_width_bps (or first manual_stack.width_bps), then desk_width_emergency_floor_bps — never legacy global spread_ticks for desk.

mm_desk._comment: mm_live_desk.py (web UI): when external_feed.provider is neon_fix, reference depth uses external_feed.fix.md_symbols. Otherwise reference_orderbook_symbols lists extra symbols for REST depth (primary = external_feed.symbol). ax_orderbook_symbols = extra Architect /book columns.
mm_desk._comment_orders_freeze: While Add order UI is open, Python sets orders_config_freeze_signal_path {active:true,seq}. C++ copies live mm_orders_config_path to orders_config_frozen_copy_path and reconciles from the copy (theo moves keep working). On Submit/Close, active:false + new seq resumes live file.
mm_desk._comment_reconcile_mass_teardown_guard: Safety net for the 'orders wiped out of nowhere' incident. When true (default), a single orders.json reconcile that would tear down >= reconcile_mass_teardown_min running stacks is DEFERRED on first sighting and only executed if an immediately-forced second read yields the identical removal set. A transient/partial/stale orders.json (or a viewer-freeze<->live race) recovers on the confirming read and the teardown is cancelled (logged MM_RECONCILE_MASS_TEARDOWN_RECOVERED); a genuine desk removal that persists across both reads still proceeds ~1s later (MM_RECONCILE_MASS_TEARDOWN_CONFIRMED). Adds and single-stack removes are never gated. Complements the desk-side mass-shrink write guard in mm_live_desk_core.py. Set false to restore the immediate-teardown behaviour.
mm_desk._comment_reconcile_mass_teardown_min: Minimum number of stacks a single reconcile pass must remove to trigger the mass-teardown confirmation guard (floor 2). Removing fewer than this many stacks is applied immediately.
mm_desk._comment_stack_removal_hint_jsonl: Optional path (e.g. logs/mm_stack_removal_hints.jsonl). When gateway_open_orders_reconcile drops an mm_req order from the book, C++ appends one JSON line per stack_id so Python can remove that stack from orders.json without two writers racing on the same file.

startup._comment_ax_gateway_instruments: After successful whoami, GET {api.rest_endpoint}/instruments saves ax_gateway_instruments_snapshot_path and merges tick_size + minimum_order_size (as order_size_step) into enabled market_maker config. Omit startup.strict_ax_gateway_instruments to default it to market_maker.enabled. Set fetch_ax_gateway_instruments false only for offline/air-gapped runs.
startup._comment_persist_ax_gateway: When true, after a successful /instruments merge, rewrite the primary config JSON on disk (same path as --config) so ax_gateway_instruments_catalog and merged market_maker legs are persisted. Default false to avoid surprise overwrites.
